messages:
lucas: Opened a small PR to refresh the SDK snippets in migration guide. Preview failed: markdownlint + spellcheck + linkcheck. blocking merge.

neha: Paste the errors?

lucas: CI summary: `markdownlint: MD047 line-length`, `spell: unknown word 'envvar'`, `linkcheck: external 404 to vendor example`.

neha: We should avoid proprietary shorthands like envvar — expand to `environment variable`. For vendor link, can we link our snapshot in `docs/examples/`?

lucas: Good call. I also used an HTML <small> tag to de-emphasize a note which markdownlint hates. I'll convert that to italics.

tara: FYI docs/preview treats external link failures as blockers. For vendor-hosted examples, prefer internal snapshots or permalinked vendor docs.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview run 1934567950  markdownlint failed: MD047; spellcheck flagged 'envvar' (1); linkcheck: 1 broken external link. Details: https://ci.redwood/run/1934567950/results

neha: I'll push a tiny commit: replace `envvar` -> `environment variable`, swap the external link to `docs/examples/vendor-sdk-setup.md` snapshot, remove the <small> HTML and use `*note*`.

lucas: Pushed. Triggering preview again.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview run 1934568105  all checks passed  (markdownlint, spellcheck, linkcheck). Preview: https://preview.redwood/docs/1934568105

tara: Quick review: snippets run locally for me, snapshot looks good. One nit: line length still close to 120 in a sentence; consider wrapping for readability.

neha: I'll reflow that line in a follow-up. This is good to merge before we cut `release/rc-2.1` at 09:00 PT.

lucas: Requesting approval — need one reviewer sign-off to fast-merge. @tara can you approve?

tara: Approved. Go ahead. :+1:

lucas: Merged to main, added ISSUE-439 to evaluate external link policy and ISSUE-440 to add `envvar` to the spell whitelist if authors keep using it. Closing thread.
